title: Post-October Credit Card Points Discussion: Does the ATO Payment Count Toward the $3K Spend Requirement?
body:
I couldn’t find this information in the fine print of two links below.
If ATO payments don’t count towards the $3,000 spend requirement, could I use Zip Pay to pay the ATO and then pay off the Zip Pay balance using my NAB credit card (or Coles Mastercard) to meet the spending requirement?
NAB Rewards Visa Card:
https://www.nab.com.au/personal/credit-cards/nab-rewards-car…
Coles No Annual Fee Mastercard:
https://www.coles.com.au/credit-cards/flybuys/no-annual-fee-…
